title: quality
description: Measured footage quality written by scripts/quality.py per clip: one segment per interval with a role and confidence plus measured defects. Segments tile the clip with no gaps. These are labels only — nothing is ever deleted or cut here; the director and the human decide. Intent and defect stay separate: blur during a whip pan is intent, blur on a hold is a defect.

path.description: absolute path of the analysed clip

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the analysis run

motion_file.description: motion JSON used for segmentation and roles, when one was found

segments.description: segments covering the whole clip in time order; every segment has end_s > start_s and there are no zero-length slivers

end_s.description: must be greater than start_s; the writer asserts it and merges sub-second slivers

confidence.description: how sure the role assignment is; setup/teardown/accidental are likely roles, never verdicts

role_evidence.description: short human-readable reasons for the role

motion_label.description: CameraBench label of the overlapping move from the motion file, or the segment's own dominant motion

defects.description: measured defects only; empty when the segment is clean

detail.description: human-readable measurement, e.g. 'laplacian 0.28x clip median' or 'horizon 3.1 deg'

metrics.description: the raw measurements behind the defects

laplacian_rel.description: Laplacian variance divided by the clip's own median

clip_high_pct.description: percent of pixels blown to white

clip_low_pct.description: percent of pixels crushed to black

obstruction.description: share of the frame that is large, low-detail and static

horizon_deg.description: roll offset of the horizon in degrees, measured from a dominant long near-horizontal line (the sea/sky boundary); null when no such line is found instead of a guess from arbitrary edges
